stack_patterns.note: Function contains stack manipulation that may cause decompiler artifacts.

patterns.impact: Causes ESP-relative offsets to become runtime-dependent. All stack variables accessed via ESP after this point will appear as separate "in_stack_XXXX" parameters.

suspects.description: Pointer value `&CStack_80` truncated by cast to `int` (sub-pointer width) — correct on the 32-bit matching build, a hard `cast from pointer to smaller type` error at 64-bit. If the value is used as an integer (delta, address print, hash), rewrite the cast as `uintptr_t`/`intptr_t` in a .keep.
